messages:
sarah-sales: Hey team — NovaHealth requested the penetration test artifacts & remediation timeline for their vendor risk review. I uploaded the bundle to S3 and attached an initial triage plan. Link: s3://redwood-sec-reports/novahealth/1719023456/ :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Automated external scan summary uploaded: 4 high / 9 medium / 12 low. Report ref: digest-1719023456.json
jordan-sec: Thx. Can we confirm what counts as "proof of fix" they want? screenshots, CVE references, patch PRs?
mike-ps: NovaHealth asked also about expected SLA for fixes during POC and whether Dedicated capacity is in scope for the pilot — I'll need a brief pricing note to hand to their procurement team.
eva-eng: FYI two of the high findings are config issues: (1) KMS key policy missing `Encrypt` principal, (2) inbound 0.0.0.0/0 on staging SG. Quick remediation steps below:
```bash
# tighten SG
aws ec2 revoke-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0abc123 --protocol tcp --port 0-65535 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0abc123 --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.0.0.0/16
# KMS example patch
aws kms put-key-policy --key-id alias/redwood --policy file://kms-policy.json
```
sarah-sales: Great — can you create two short remediation PRs (kms-policy + sg-lockdown) and drop links here? We'll attach PRs as evidence.
eva-eng: PRs created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/728 (sg) and /pull/729 (kms). Added short test steps and screenshots in the PR descriptions.
jordan-sec: For triage, propose: handoff day (T0): deliver artifacts + call; T0+7 days: evidence for high findings; T0+14 days: medium completed; T0+30 days: low + final report. We should flag any findings that require customer change as "customer action" vs "redwood fix" in the timeline.
alice-novahealth: Thanks — that cadence works for us. Also can you include a mapping to the SIG/CAIQ controls? Our audit team will want that for the vendor review packet.
mike-ps: Noted, I'll attach a one-page pricing addendum for Dedicated pilot options and expected timeline for SLA ramp.
jordan-sec: I'll prepare the SIG/CAIQ mapping. Suggest we add a 30-minute triage call tomorrow 10am PT — @alice-novahealth can you make that?
alice-novahealth: Yes, 10am PT works. Please include remediation owners and a concise list of required evidence per finding (e.g., patch diff, screenshot, logs, test repro steps).
sarah-sales: Owners: eva-eng (infrastructure fixes), jordan-sec (evidence validation), mike-ps (customer comms/pricing). I'll update the handoff doc in S3 with owners & checksums. Checksums: sha256sum manifest available at s3://redwood-sec-reports/novahealth/1719023456/checksums.txt
jordan-sec: For compliance artifacts, we'll add SOC2 control mapping and CAIQ crosswalk. I'll drop in the shared drive before the call.
deploy-bot: CRC verify: all uploaded artifacts present. checksums.txt matched (OK).
eva-eng: Quick note: one medium finding is a stale dependency in our xgboost container; created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/containers/pull/142 that updates base image and runs unit tests.
mike-ps: I'll prepare the customer-facing remediation timeline PDF and attach to the ticket after the call.
alice-novahealth: Appreciate the fast turnaround — we'll bring this to our legal/security committee next week. Please ensure the PRs include test evidence; they prefer short replayable steps rather than just screenshots.
sarah-sales: Copy — team will add replay steps. After the call I'll tag the thread with the official deliverable links. :thumbsup:
